signature.revocation: OPSTRUTH_REVOKED_VERIFIER_FINGERPRINTS denylist is checked before signature acceptance

replay.scope: one accepted response per runId plus verificationNonce and handoffDigest
replay.uncertainRetry: an uncertain response advances the event chain, producing a fresh handoff and nonce for a subsequent independent observation

decisionRule.verified: no subject errors, no incomplete actions, at least one requirement result, and every requirement VERIFIED
decisionRule.failed: exact head mismatch, any CONTRADICTED requirement, or an incomplete action in FAILED or AMBIGUOUS state
decisionRule.uncertain: all other partial or unavailable evidence states

compatibility.legacyAttestationOnly: accepted only for objectives created before verificationContractVersion was recorded
